name: cheap-7-v2
description: Seven independent labs vote, none of them the author's, all on current-generation models through one OpenRouter key: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna, Google Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek v4.1 Flash, Z.ai GLM 5.3 Flash, Qwen 3.7 Plus, MiniMax M3, Mistral Medium 3.5. Blind proposals, debate, unanimous signoff. Anthropic Sonnet 5 writes the skeleton, the draft, every revision and the handoff and holds NO panel seat; Meta Llama 4 Maverick writes the criteria and also holds no panel seat, so neither the lab that drafts nor the lab that sets the bar votes on whether the bar was cleared. This is the revision of cheap-7 after its first real run, where one lab held the criteria, skeleton, builder, reviser and handoff seats AND a critic seat, voted on its own draft, and a claim it wrote survived to the deliverable. Anthropic is deliberately absent from the panel: plans from this chain are read by a Claude session before anything is built, so that review happens downstream rather than inside the vote. Kimi K3 is deliberately absent too - a seat that may route through another lab is not an independent seat. Every seat gets a 36000-token ceiling and reasoning is left on: a debate is not squeezed to a short answer, and a reply cut off at the ceiling is retried once, then the seat is re-asked alone - it is never counted as agreement. The cap is a ceiling, not a price; only generated tokens are billed. Prices are from src/pricing.json, refreshed against OpenRouter's live model list on 2026-09-20 - price a real task with `npm run dry` before running.
